resources.string: Shows messages in WhatsApp and Messenger in the language you\'re learning, right over the original. Tap a message to see the original. Translation happens on your phone: messages are never stored or sent anywhere.

Messages in your language show up in the language you\'re learning, right where they are in WhatsApp and Messenger. Tap a message to peek at the original; tap again to go back. Long-press to show or hide all originals.
Language I\'m learning (messages are shown in it)
My language (messages in it get translated)
Language packs need downloading (about 30 MB each).
Off — turn it on in Accessibility settings.
If Android says the setting is restricted (apps installed outside the Play Store), open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Also on the quick settings tile, so you can pause it from anywhere.

Language Lens only looks at WhatsApp and Messenger, and only at the messages on screen. It translates them on your phone with Google\'s ML Kit; the text is never stored, logged or sent anywhere. The only internet use is downloading language packs. Android shows a warning when you turn it on because Accessibility apps can read the screen.
